role: The block-callback worklist: World.setBlock's callbacks (breakBlock, onBlockAdded, onNeighborBlockChange), the notifications, the immediate schedule and the liquid ticks run as steps over an explicit per-env frame stack, in vanilla's depth-first order, instead of calling each other.

structs.name: bwl_op
structs.java: one call: which method, its arguments

structs.name: bwl_frame
structs.java: one call in progress: its op, resume point and the locals that live across its calls

structs.name: bwl
structs.java: the JVM stack's frames for this cycle

gpu: the stack is fixed (BWL_CAP 4096 frames, BWL_EMIT_CAP 128 ops per step) and overflow aborts; the deepest measured is 895 frames (make -C csrc worklist-depth)
ops carry a struct world pointer and a jrand pointer (the liquid tick's Random): a device copy needs them as indices
notes: make -C csrc worklist-depth (csrc/tests/wldepth.sh) builds with NETHERITE_WL_DEPTH and reports each explicit stack's deepest point and the run that reached it.
